_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: William Archer (1856-1924) beyond Ibsen: Nansen's Eskimo Life (1893) and Kielland's Tales of Two Countries (1891). His Ibsen is on archer-ibsen_shelf.json (lane C), which already records Gutenberg's single-play files as duplicates. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 35); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

_excluded.single-play-ibsen: Gutenberg's single Ibsen plays (4070, 4093, 4782, 7942, 8121, 18428, 18792) are excluded on archer-ibsen_shelf.json as duplicates of the collected set.

_name_words_note: Translator name only: fetch_shelf.py treats it as the identity check, so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
